media_assets_dimensions_positive.name: media_assets_dimensions_positive
media_assets_dimensions_positive.value: ("media_assets"."width" is null or "media_assets"."width" > 0) and ("media_assets"."height" is null or "media_assets"."height" > 0)

novel_daily_stats_nonnegative.name: novel_daily_stats_nonnegative
novel_daily_stats_nonnegative.value: "novel_daily_stats"."views" >= 0 and "novel_daily_stats"."unique_readers" >= 0 and "novel_daily_stats"."chapter_reads" >= 0 and "novel_daily_stats"."chapter_completions" >= 0 and "novel_daily_stats"."library_adds" >= 0 and "novel_daily_stats"."follows" >= 0 and "novel_daily_stats"."ratings" >= 0 and "novel_daily_stats"."reviews" >= 0

chapters_heat_level_valid.name: chapters_heat_level_valid
chapters_heat_level_valid.value: ("chapters"."inherit_story_heat_level" and "chapters"."heat_level" is null) or (not "chapters"."inherit_story_heat_level" and "chapters"."heat_level" between 1 and 5)

chapters_free_price_consistent.name: chapters_free_price_consistent
chapters_free_price_consistent.value:
("chapters"."access_mode" = 'free' and "chapters"."is_free" and "chapters"."coin_price" = 0)
        or ("chapters"."access_mode" = 'paid' and not "chapters"."is_free" and "chapters"."coin_price" > 0)
        or ("chapters"."access_mode" in ('early_access', 'members_only') and not "chapters"."is_free" and "chapters"."coin_price" = 0)

chapters_early_access_valid.name: chapters_early_access_valid
chapters_early_access_valid.value:
("chapters"."access_mode" <> 'early_access' and "chapters"."public_available_at" is null and "chapters"."public_access_mode_after_early_access" is null and "chapters"."public_coin_price" is null)
        or ("chapters"."access_mode" = 'early_access' and "chapters"."public_available_at" is not null and "chapters"."public_access_mode_after_early_access" is not null
          and (("chapters"."public_access_mode_after_early_access" = 'free' and "chapters"."public_coin_price" is null)
            or ("chapters"."public_access_mode_after_early_access" = 'paid' and "chapters"."public_coin_price" > 0)))

chapters_publication_dates_valid.name: chapters_publication_dates_valid
chapters_publication_dates_valid.value: ("chapters"."status" <> 'PUBLISHED' or "chapters"."published_at" is not null) and ("chapters"."status" <> 'SCHEDULED' or "chapters"."scheduled_for" is not null)

novels_publication_dates_valid.name: novels_publication_dates_valid
novels_publication_dates_valid.value: ("novels"."publication_status" <> 'PUBLISHED' or "novels"."published_at" is not null) and ("novels"."publication_status" <> 'SCHEDULED' or "novels"."scheduled_for" is not null)

promo_banners_window_valid.name: promo_banners_window_valid
promo_banners_window_valid.value: "promo_banners"."starts_at" is null or "promo_banners"."ends_at" is null or "promo_banners"."starts_at" < "promo_banners"."ends_at"

chapter_unlocks_refund_state_valid.name: chapter_unlocks_refund_state_valid
chapter_unlocks_refund_state_valid.value: ("chapter_unlocks"."refunded_at" is null and "chapter_unlocks"."refund_ledger_entry_id" is null) or ("chapter_unlocks"."refunded_at" is not null and "chapter_unlocks"."refund_ledger_entry_id" is not null)

coin_ledger_entries_revenue_valid.name: coin_ledger_entries_revenue_valid
coin_ledger_entries_revenue_valid.value: "coin_ledger_entries"."eligible_revenue_minor" >= 0 and (("coin_ledger_entries"."eligible_revenue_minor" = 0 and "coin_ledger_entries"."revenue_currency" is null) or ("coin_ledger_entries"."eligible_revenue_minor" > 0 and "coin_ledger_entries"."revenue_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'))

coin_ledger_entries_direction_valid.name: coin_ledger_entries_direction_valid
coin_ledger_entries_direction_valid.value:
("coin_ledger_entries"."type" = 'CHAPTER_UNLOCK' and "coin_ledger_entries"."amount" < 0)
        or ("coin_ledger_entries"."type" in ('TOP_UP', 'ADMIN_CREDIT', 'PROMOTION', 'REFUND') and "coin_ledger_entries"."amount" > 0)
        or ("coin_ledger_entries"."type" = 'ADJUSTMENT' and "coin_ledger_entries"."amount" <> 0)

coin_wallets_paid_value_valid.name: coin_wallets_paid_value_valid
coin_wallets_paid_value_valid.value: "coin_wallets"."paid_value_minor" >= 0 and ("coin_wallets"."paid_balance" > 0 or "coin_wallets"."paid_value_minor" = 0) and (("coin_wallets"."paid_value_minor" = 0 and "coin_wallets"."paid_value_currency" is null) or ("coin_wallets"."paid_value_minor" > 0 and "coin_wallets"."paid_value_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'))
